name: infinity-run-marathon
description: Infinity Run Marathon Web Application & Admin Control Panel

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
